description:
Your AILANG Parse account: plan, monthly usage and limits, your keys, and
whether request history is kept.
Actions:
  "status"  (default) → plan, usage this month and remaining allowance
  "keys"              → your keys with per-key usage ("usage" is an alias)
  "history"           → whether request history (parsed output kept for
                        replay) is on for your account
  "history_on" / "history_off" → change it for the account and all its keys
name: mcpAccount
title: Account, quota and usage
